title: Van earthquake of 2011
summary: A severe earthquake struck near Erciş and Van in eastern Turkey on 23 October 2011. More than 570 people were killed and thousands of structures were destroyed. It was felt as far away as Jordan and southern Russia. Rescue and relief were led by Turkey's Ministry of Health and the Turkish Red Crescent.

importance.justification: Deadly regional earthquake with more than 570 deaths and widespread destruction, but limited global historical reach.

audience_note: Mentions mass death and building collapse from an earthquake.
